gameplan.summary: Scale into an unstoppable carry with knockup combos and unlimited Windwall. Win through mobility.
gameplan.win_condition: Set up Last Breath combos with allied knockups. Dash through minions to avoid skillshots.
gameplan.early_game: Q stack tornado poke. E through minions aggressively. Shield absorbs one hit — trade into it.
gameplan.positioning: Dash to backline in teamfights. Never stand still — constant E dashing makes you impossible to hit.

malphite.tips: He hard-counters you — armor passive, point-and-click ult. Rush Wit's End for MR and on-hit. Farm and roam.
malphite.power_shift: He wins 1v1 all game. Win by roaming to other lanes and avoiding him entirely.

pantheon.tips: His E blocks your Q. Never dash to him — he blocks it. Poke with tornado at max range only.
pantheon.power_shift: He wins early hard. You outscale at 3 items if you survived laning phase.

annie.tips: Windwall her Q and W. Always track her stun count — if she has 4 stacks, disengage immediately.
annie.power_shift: You outscale at 2 items. Win by Windwalling her burst and outlasting her damage.

zed.tips: Windwall his Q poke. Time W shadow to avoid his ult. Buy Verdant Barrier early.
zed.power_shift: He wins early; you win at 2 items with shield. Equal matchup with Shieldbow rush.

akali.tips: Never dash into her shroud — she all-ins you there. Poke with tornado. Save E dash for escape not engage.
akali.power_shift: Even. She outbursts; you outscale in sustained fights. Win via teamfight mobility.
